methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA signals intentional community-based AI education infrastructure that could seed distributed fluency beyond traditional tech hubs, creating peer learning networks across Richmond's diverse economic base.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Opinion piece explicitly diagnosing data center concentration in NoVA as exacerbating urban-rural divide signals awareness that infrastructure deployment without capability distribution widens inequality rather than bridging it.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches online workforce training program - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Online workforce training via ed2go platform enables broad access in underserved Roanoke region, but platform-mediated delivery model suggests shallow adoption rather than deep technical capability building.

signals.title: U.Va. pilots three new artificial intelligence literacy courses - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA piloting AI literacy courses across curriculum signals institutional commitment to democratizing foundational AI fluency statewide, potentially seeding distributed peer networks through educated alumni returning to diverse Virginia regions.

signals.title: State invests $3M to help transform Hampton Roads into hub for aircraft technology and training - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Targeted $3M state investment in Hampton Roads aircraft tech hub reinforces sector-specific deep capability clustering in existing metro centers, following established pattern of concentrating advanced technical capacity in urban nodes.
